name: Exclusive-lead, pay-on-booking exchange for one home-service trade in one metro
buyer: Solo or very small handyman, house-cleaning or similar crews that pay per lead on Thumbtack or Angi today
pain: Shared pay-per-lead pricing: each lead goes to 3-5 pros and is billed whether or not the homeowner replies. Lead cost eats a large share of small-ticket jobs.
wedge: One licence-free trade in one metro. Each lead goes to one pro only, and the pro is charged only when the job is booked or confirmed. Homeowner traffic comes from local SEO, in a rank-and-rent style.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: Exclusive single-pro routing with a pay-on-confirmed-booking fee, so the pro pays nothing for no-reply or just-exploring leads. The $100 figure is a model assumption, not an observed price.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If the entrant's own homeowner-traffic cost per booked job (SEO plus ads) exceeds roughly $100, or pros take bookings off-platform and avoid the fee, the edge disappears.
scan1Edge.unit: USD charged to the pro per booked job

substitutesNoted.name: Thumbtack
substitutesNoted.price_point: $15-$80 per shared lead; ~$350 per booked job

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: ESTIMATE from the notes: 40-60% gross margin if the entrant owns the traffic, falling quickly if paid ads are required. No per-booking price has been validated.

majorUncertainty: Whether the entrant can get homeowner demand at a cost per booked job below what pros pay Thumbtack. This is the cold start on both sides.
unknowns: Local SEO ranking difficulty and cost per homeowner request in a chosen metro
Share of bookings that leak off-platform after first contact
State licence rules for the chosen trade
Whether pros will accept a pay-on-booking fee that is verifiable
Whether Thumbtack has a free tier (not verified)
BBB complaint figures are only a secondary blog summary
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Depends on Google organic and paid traffic. Some trades need state licences, so restrict to licence-free trades or verify licences (legal specifics not researched).
